name: openeyetrack
description: Browser-native webcam eye tracking for behavioural research

scripts.build:sdk: vite build --config vite.config.sdk.ts && vite build --config vite.config.worker.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.sdk.json
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:sdk
scripts.pack:sdk: npm run package:sdk && npm run verify:sdk-package && node scripts/pack-sdk.mjs
scripts.build:sdk-portable-test: npm run package:sdk && node scripts/build-portable-sdk-test.mjs && node scripts/verify-sdk-portable-test.mjs
